notes.title: Update V0.2.0 - Tides of Change
notes.notes:
[h2]Introducing: Runes[/h2][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44806523/e542040fdb04fa0fa6c1518080fd31595d14e7a5.png"][/img][/h2][p]Runes are your quintessential run modifiers.[/p][p]From double boss fights to flipped item rarities, these runes will encourage new playstyle and give you some additional gameplay variety![/p][p]Runes are unlocked through achievements, similarly to weapons.[/p][p]They are all unlocked relatively easily to keep them accessible, so just play a little and you'll get them with no problem 🙂[/p][p]Hope they spice up your runs!
[/p][h2]Weapons: Dagger, Guardian's Bulwark & Eye Of The Abyss[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44806523/26332154a2f8dd4b8bd73a4ed9a2e3a7ddb1ac51.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44806523/745fb90c88d169b8a51669c059abee33b42320f9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44806523/d4088a92b84e2445a75955a0cd13f611451f15b6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Here are some new weapon types we're introducing. To differentiate the new weapons from the existing ones, the direction we've taken was to design new and interesting gimmicks for these new weapons, which we hope would offer new and interesting playstyles for you to enjoy!
[/p][h2]Balance changes:[/h2][h3]Weapon Reworks: Molten Sickle & Blighted Trident[/h3][p]We've been wanting to rework these for a while now as they felt rather weak or outdated compared to more recent weapons and to compensate for the status effect damage nerf in an earlier patch.[/p][p]Here are the changes:[/p][h3]Molten sickle:[/h3][p]• Slightly changed the timing of sickle's attacks.[/p][p]• Strengthened the ability, ability now inflicts overheat, and explosion damage has been increased.[/p][h3]Blighted Trident:[/h3][p]• Attacks now have a chance to poison[/p][p]• Poison duration from the ability has been increased.[/p][p][/p][h2]Item Updates:[/h2][p]• Lucid bastion hp & damage has been reduced[/p][p]• Tidepiercer damage has been reduced[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2][p]• Generation: Generation has been fully fixed, this means no more floating altars, no more wrongly placed chests, no more missing stuff, everything is exactly where it should be.[/p][p]• Molten sickle: Previously the explosion did no damage[/p][p]• Blobber's first trait, Septic Shock, was previously shooting 50x the number of projectiles it was supposed to, causing an immense amount of lag. This has been resolved.[/p][p]• Deathscreen previously may have missing stats display.[/p][p]• Fixed an issue where the player could not access the Boss Rush after finishing a run in the lobby tutorial.[/p][p]• Magma eye's projectile now shoots correctly[/p][p][/p][h2]Small Changes:[/h2][p]• Perforator did not have a boss icon, this has been fixed.[/p][p]• Starting Boss Rush fight now removes all active dropped items off the map.[/p][p]• Some enemies gain hyperarmour while doing charge attacks[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.1.80a Now Live! Bug Fixes & Performance Boosts
notes.notes:
Updates:
[list]
[*] Improved controller support. The D-pad can now move the cursor.
[*] Optimized performance and reduced lag during gameplay.
[*] Added a damage threshold to trigger boss fights.
[*] Soul Sword now refills to 100% after defeating a boss in Boss Rush.
[*] Adjusted Sea Angel’s “Last Stand” trait for Boss Rush.
[*] Players can now dash without any directional input.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Abyssal Valor stat boosts weren’t removed when the item was lost.
[*] Fixed an issue where Ruination Axe failed to interact correctly with Spearhead.

[/list]

Next Up:
We’re working on an audio update to enhance your gameplay experience! Stay tuned!

If you have any feedback, suggestions, or questions, do drop us a message on our Discord server : )

notes.title: Update 0.1.70a – Balance Changes & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
v0.1.70a Patch Notes

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Damage" and "Damage Taken" stats were not being registered.
[*] Fixed an issue where item unlocks failed to sync with achievements, causing some items to be incorrectly unobtainable.
[*] Fixed an issue where Charon's Obol failed to spawn projectiles after a certain amount of usage.
[*] Fixed an issue where resolution adjustments made through the pause menu were not being applied.
[*] Fixed an issue where, under certain circumstances, Sea Angel became invulnerable.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Seafarer's Compass indicator did not disappear.
[/list]

Balance Changes:
[list]
[*] Abyssal Valor's cooldown has been increased.
[*] Damage from Poison and Overheat has been reduced.
[*] Drop rates for legendary items have been adjusted.
[*] Charon's Obol hitbox has been increased.
[*] Health pools for some bosses have been adjusted.
[*] Health and damage values for some enemies have been adjusted.
[*] Currency drop amounts from enemies have been adjusted.
[*] EXP requirements for level-ups have been adjusted.
[*] Unwanted Sentience's range and projectile count have been reduced.
[*] I-frames during dashes have been adjusted.
[/list]

Quality of Life:
[list]
[*] Added an option to press ESC to return to the main menu from the lobby.
[/list]

The first batch of balance changes is finally out!
We'll be closely listening to your feedback on these changes to continuously improve your player experience : )

Don’t forget to join our Discord and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Hotfix v0.1.15a
notes.notes:
Hey ya'll!

A hotfix patched was dropped yesterday with the following bugs being fixed:
-Localization options are now visible regardless of aspect ratio
-Soul Constructs persist after Guardian Construct dies (Boss Rush)
-Blighted Trident's ability description not displaying
-Certain things don't trigger certain on hit items
-Trying to unlock a biome chest without a key still checks the checklist task
-Lobby movement stutter
-Dropped xp objects are now limited, preventing lag spikes when killing high health bosses

We are aware of the bug where you reach 0 health but do not die as well as the one where you become immortal, we're actively working on these bugs!

Happy divin ;)
